novelty.justification: The claim proposes a new cross-domain measurement package—“near-invariant to preserving transforms and sensitive to violating transforms,” combined with “linear decodability” and prediction of “physically inconsistent outputs”—rather than a fundamentally new representation principle. Searches for “latent representation invariance conservation laws scientific foundation models,” “probing symmetry equivariance pretrained molecular representations,” and “internal representations physical consistency foundation models” found adjacent work including Lenc and Vedaldi’s representation-equivariance measurements, the 2025 GraphCast interpretability study “Towards mechanistic understanding in a data-driven weather model,” and “Scaling Laws and Symmetry, Evidence from Neural Force Fields,” but no essentially equivalent per-law audit spanning preserving and violating transformations. The step is therefore a non-trivial but natural extension of standard invariance/equivariance measurement and linear probing to scientific conservation laws; its main novelty is the systematic CIS operationalization and link to output violations, not the claimed “invariant directions” mechanism itself.
